401:t_1:60.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Only by continuing to explore can we forge our future with our own hands.」

401:t_1:61.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Is that why you began manipulating the human genome, despite the taboo against it?」

401:t_1:62.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Should we be condemned for that? We have information that the Federation government has already begun tests to create humans adapted to the environment.」

401:t_1:63.en:
$$マツモト$$
「And the vast cryogenic sleep facility reportedly being built on the Moon could also be called a violation of the natural order of human life.」

401:t_1:64.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「You continue to give us unconfirmed information, but...」

401:t_1:65.en:
$$マツモト$$
「This is a good opportunity, and I want everyone to know those facts as well.」

401:t_1:66.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「The Federation government remains focused on rebuilding Earth, as you say. But what you are aiming for is...」

401:t_1:67.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We are aiming for space, of course.」

401:t_1:68.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Our ultimate goal is to find a planet we can colonize and make it a second Earth.」

401:t_1:69.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Let me show you our results.」

401:t_1:70.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「W-wait! A discussion like that wasn't on the agenda...」

401:t_1:71.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...I apologize. The $$イボルバー$$ have already taken control of this program.」

401:t_1:73.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Now, let us show everyone watching some of the $$イボルバー$$' research results.」

401:t_1:78.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Finding a planet we can colonize will take decades, or even centuries, at a minimum.」

401:t_1:79.en:
$$マツモト$$
「There is only one way to overcome this problem: applying biology in addition to mechanical engineering.」

401:t_1:80.en:
$$マツモト$$
「By evolving the human body itself, we can adapt to the vacuum of space, astronomical distances, and immense spans of time.」

401:t_1:81.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Isn't this... a desecration of life...?」

401:t_1:82.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Are you one of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, too?」

401:t_1:83.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「$$クロノ$$...?」

401:t_1:84.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Humanity as a whole is being called upon to evolve. That war made it clear.」

401:t_1:85.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We are not inheriting $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s ideals. We seek evolution in a different form from the vision he advocates.」

401:t_1:86.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...The symbiont is a wonderful invention. It can breathe oxygen underwater and withstand deep-sea pressure. Eventually, it will adapt to a vacuum at absolute zero.」

401:t_1:87.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Nourishment is supplied through symbiosis with nanomachines. It resembles photosynthesis, but is more efficient.」

401:t_1:88.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I have already undergone this surgery myself. In time, I will become something beyond human.」

401:t_1:89.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We $$イボルバー$$ welcome all those who wish to live in the future together with us.」

401:t_1:90.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Let us grasp evolution through our own power, and forge our future with our own hands.」

401:t_1:94.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...That is all the information that can be played back.」

401:t_1:95.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ are... humans who modified themselves...」

401:t_1:96.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have found numerous contradictions with official $$人類銀河同盟$$ information. Its credibility is extremely low.」

401:t_1:97.en:
$$レド$$
「Then what was that data!? Who made it, and for what purpose!?」

401:t_1:98.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I hypothesize that this may be disinformation from the enemy.」

401:t_1:99.en:
$$レド$$
「The enemy? What enemy!? Weren't the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ inferior life-forms!?」

401:t_1:100.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have detected surviving $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$. I will destroy them.」

401:t_10:5.en:
$n
「I followed your advice and tried fighting with just the $$ジェニオン$$.」

401:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Isn't your training starting to pay off? You seemed to hold your own quite well.」

401:t_10:7.en:
$n
「It really drove home how much I'd been relying on Miss $$スズネ$$.」

401:t_10:8.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ was originally a single-seater, so I have to be able to handle it like that.」

401:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come to think of it, you're right. I'd become so used to having two pilots that I completely forgot.」

401:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But by fighting the whole battle in the $$ジェニオン$$, you generated 50 Z in Z-Chips, $n. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

401:t_10:11.en:
$n
「I feel like I'm close to grasping something... That hope must have produced the Z-Chips.」

401:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Shall I give you a little despair as well, to balance things out?」

401:t_10:13.en:
$n
「I'll pass. I've already got plenty of headaches.」

401:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Still, it is a relief that our strange intruder has taken $n's mind off things.)

401:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But the original $$ジェニオン$$...? What an intriguing choice of words.)

401:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now, $$エイミー$$... If you look so down when $$レド$$ returns, he won't know what to do.」

401:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You came all the way to the $$霧の海$$ because you were worried, didn't you?」

401:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand how you feel, $$エイミー$$, but $$レド$$ grew up in a very different environment from everyone in the fleet.」

401:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just as you have your own way of thinking, $$エイミー$$, $$レド$$ has his.」

401:t_10:27.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So it isn't a matter of which of us is right?」

401:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. And living in the multiverse means learning to reconcile such differences.」

401:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since leaving the fleet, you've often found things surprising, unacceptable, or hard to get used to, haven't you, $$エイミー$$?」

401:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What you're feeling now is the same thing.」

401:t_10:32.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...I understand, $$ＡＧ$$. When $$レド$$ gets back, we'll think about what to do next together.」

401:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome. I would hate to say goodbye to my fellow robot, $$チェインバー#pilot$$, too.」

401:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I will save the ace pilot celebration for another occasion.」

401:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that your smile is back, $$エイミー$$, let us begin! Let's give it our all again today...」

402:t_000:0.en:
$$レド$$
「At this depth, the $$ヒカリムシ$$ don't seem to have as much of an effect...」

402:t_000:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The targets, known as $$クジライカ$$, have adapted their exoskeletons to the environment, but their genes show no difference from $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

402:t_000:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I identify them as the same species.」

402:t_000:3.en:
$$レド$$
「It is as I thought. ...The decision to annihilate them is correct. It is necessary for Earth's humanity, too.」

402:t_000:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on my linguistic analysis, I infer that Earth's humanity defines its survival strategy very differently from the Alliance.」

402:t_000:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The answer to that question is absent from the Alliance's standard dictionary. However, it exists in Earth's language.」

402:t_000:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is 'coexistence and mutual prosperity'.」
